_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.49.0 and beamlynx-ui to its tagged 0.66.0, a pair that has to move together: beamlynx-ui 0.66.0 needs pine-lang 0.49 (its RequiredVersion) for checkpoints, limit: N per, group: ... with, SQL to Pine, JSON paths and the launch token this app sends.
